## Reading in Data online

```{r}
datacsv <-read_csv("https://www4.stat.ncsu.edu/~online/ST308/Data/lbmoy2_balance-scale.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

rd <- datacsv$Right_Distance


meanrd <- mean(rd, na.rm = TRUE)

print(meanrd)
```
